infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MTS Vendors needs camera access to let you take photos for your services and portfolio.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MTS Vendors needs photo library access to let you upload a business logo, banner, service images, and portfolio gallery.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MTS Vendors needs microphone access for audio recording features.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MTS Vendors needs your location to display your business location to customers.
